item.title: 盘屿 0.9.9
item.description:
盘屿 0.9.9
· 新功能：应用内拷贝显示实时速度；点“拷贝到这块盘…”或把文件拖进盘屿窗口即可查看。 · 速度按最近约 3 秒的实际传输量计算，暂停和核对时隐藏；继续拷贝后重新统计，跳过或复用的文件不会计入速度。
对应源码：https://qisw.top/volisle/updates/Volisle-0.9.9-81-source.tar.gz

Volisle 0.9.9
· New: Live transfer speed for in-app copies. Choose Copy to This Disk or drag files into the Volisle window to see it. · Speed reflects data transferred over roughly the last three seconds. It hides during pause and comparison, restarts after resuming, and excludes skipped or reused files.
Source code: https://qisw.top/volisle/updates/Volisle-0.9.9-81-source.tar.gz
